content.study:
Section 56 — Evidence

Section 56 prescribes the documentary evidence required for enforcement of a Geneva Convention foreign award, including the award, arbitration agreement and evidence establishing the award's foreign status under the statutory scheme.

Apply the provision within Chapter II of Part II and identify the precise Convention framework, statutory condition and enforcement consequence. Do not treat enforcement as a merits appeal.
